payload.description: Whether the fees licensing collects cover what the service costs to run. Fee levels for alcohol licensing are fixed in national regulations, so a council spending more than it takes in cannot simply charge more. Norwich publishes neither side of that sum for licensing on its own: not in the 2026-2027 budget, not in the fees book, and not in the payments-over-£500 data.
